renders._yaml:
- component: figure
  id: signature_share_bar
  title: Share of SNVs per signature
  description: |-
    Each bar is the percent of a tumor's SNVs that SIGS allocates to one COSMIC mutational signature. It answers which mutational processes shaped the tumor.
    How to read: tall bars are the dominant processes, for instance clock-like, APOBEC, homologous recombination deficiency or mismatch repair signatures, so read each signature's aetiology in COSMIC. The MISALLOC bar is the share the fitted signatures do not explain.
    Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hartwigmedical/hmftools/master/sigs/README.md
  visu_type: bar
  dict_kwargs:
    x: signature
    y: percent
    color: sample
    labels:
      signature: COSMIC signature
      percent: Share of SNVs (%)
      sample: Tumor

- component: card
  id: signature_snv_total
  title: SNVs allocated to signatures
  description: |-
    The hero number is the total count of SNVs allocated to signatures, with the median and the largest allocation beside it, and the bars rank the signatures by SNVs. It answers how many mutations the fit explains and which signatures carry most of them.
    How to read: a high total with a few dominant signatures is a clear mutational process. A large MISALLOC share means the signature set explains the tumor poorly.
    Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hartwigmedical/hmftools/master/sigs/README.md
  column: allocation
  aggregation: sum
  aggregations:
  - median
  - max
  secondary_layout: top_n
  breakdown_col: signature
  top_n_count: 3
  caption: SNVs, by signature
  headline: true

- component: table
  title: Signature allocation
  description: |-
    Each row is a tumor and a signature with the SNVs allocated to it, the fraction and the percent of the tumor's SNVs. It answers the exact allocation behind the bars.
    How to read: sort by percent to list the main signatures, and compare tumors by filtering on the signature.
